# CANDIDATE: RSI_EXTREME_RIBBON_CONFLUENCE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When RSI is oversold (<30), the EMA ribbon is bullish aligned (8-EMA > 21-EMA > 55-EMA), and price is above VWAP, a mean-reversion long edge appears. This confluence suggests exhaustion of selling pressure, underlying bullish momentum, and intraday demand, creating a high-probability bounce opportunity.

## Mechanism

Entry triggers when: RSI(14) < 30, 8-EMA > 21-EMA > 55-EMA, close > VWAP, and the 5-minute bar closes bullish (close > open) with volume > average 5-minute volume. Enter long at the bar's close. Exit: initial stop at the entry bar's low, TP1 at 1R (equal risk-reward), then trail the remaining position using a premium-stop of 8% of ATR to capture extended moves.

   - Blow-up scenario: Gap-down open below entry bar's stop causing stop skip and loss exceeding predefined risk.
